title: Homemade Smoked Trout Fishcakes
subtitle: with charred broccoli, capers, feta & pecan nut salad
description: We've put a delicious new twist on an old classic. Homemade smoked trout fishcakes are loaded with sweet potato, which is perfectly complemented by fresh dill, chives, capers and lemon zest. Served with a charred broccoli & feta salad and silky crème fraîche for dunking. It's absolutely fabulous!

ingredients.name: Sweet Potato
ingredients.prep: peeled, rinsed & cut into bite-sized chunks

instructions.title: SWEET TATERS
instructions.text: Preheat the oven to 200°C. Place the sweet potato chunks in a pot and submerge in salted water. Place over medium-high heat and bring to the boil. Once boiling, simmer for 10-15 minutes until soft. Drain and place in a bowl. Mash with a fork or potato masher and set aside to cool in the fridge for at least 10 minutes.

instructions.title: PREPARATION STATION
instructions.text: Place the pecan nuts in a pan over medium heat. Toast for 3-5 minutes until golden brown, shifting occasionally. Remove from the pan on completion and roughly chop. Set aside. Roughly chop the trout ribbons. Loosen the crème fraîche with a splash of water and a squeeze of lemon juice.

instructions.title: HI, SWEETCAKES!
instructions.text: When the sweet potato has cooled, add the chopped trout, ½ the chopped dill, ½ the sliced chives, ½ the chopped capers, the lemon zest (to taste), the corn flour, and a sprinkle of pepper to the bowl. Mix until combined. Wet your hands slightly to prevent the mixture from sticking to them and roll into 2-3 fishcakes per portion.

instructions.title: GOLDEN DELICIOUS
instructions.text: Place the fishcakes on a greased baking tray and lightly coat in oil. Bake in the hot oven for 15-20 minutes. In the final 5 minutes, turn the oven to the grill setting or the highest temperature and grill until golden brown and cooked through.

instructions.title: BROC MY WORLD
instructions.text: Return the pan to a medium-high heat with a drizzle of oil. When hot, fry the broccoli pieces for 6-7 minutes or until lightly charred. Season to taste.

instructions.title: GREEN MACHINE
instructions.text: In a salad bowl, combine the charred broccoli, the rinsed green leaves, the remaining capers, the drained feta, the chopped nuts, a squeeze of lemon juice, seasoning, and a drizzle of oil. Toss until combined.

instructions.title: DIVINE!
instructions.text: Plate up the homemade fishcakes. Side with the charred broccoli salad. Garnish with the remaining dill and chives. Serve with the loosened crème fraîche for dunking. Well done, Chef!
